summary: Quince Therapeutics filed Amendment No. 2 to Form 8-K, updating financial disclosures for its completed acquisition of Orphai Therapeutics, LLC (and HoldCo). The amendment adds audited Orphai financials for 2024-2025, interim 2026 statements, pro forma combined financials, and business/risk factor info. Terms (price, premium, structure) are not disclosed in this filing. The original 8-K reported completion on May 17, 2026. No advisor or recommendation named. Watch for integration execution and any contingent payments or earnouts in prior or future filings.
